connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Integrating NordPass with Microsoft Sentinel SIEM via the API will allow you to automatically transfer Activity Log data from NordPass to Microsoft Sentinel and get real-time insights, such as item activity, all login attempts, and security notifications.

customs.description: Ensure that the [resource group](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-resource-manager/management/manage-resource-groups-portal#create-resource-groups) and the [Log Analytics workspace](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/logs/quick-create-workspace?tabs=azure-portal) are created and located in the same region so you can deploy the Azure Functions.
[Add Microsoft Sentinel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/quickstart-onboard#enable-microsoft-sentinel-) to the created Log Analytics workspace.

Generate a [Microsoft Sentinel API URL and token](https://www.google.com/url?q=https://support.nordpass.com/hc/en-us/articles/31972037289873&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1743770997230005&usg=AOvVaw16p0hstJ6OeBBoFdBKZRfr) in the NordPass Admin Panel to finish the Azure Functions integration. Please note that you’ll need the NordPass Enterprise account for that.

**Important:** This connector uses Azure Functions to retrieve Activity Logs from NordPass into Microsoft Sentinel. This may result in additional data ingestion costs. For more information, refer to the Azure Functions pricing page.

instructionSteps.description:
To proceed with the Microsoft Sentinel setup

1. Click the **Deploy to Azure** button below. 

	[![Deploy To Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://aka.ms/sentinel-Nordpass-azuredeploy)
2. **Please note that after the successful deployment, the system pulls Activity Log data every 1 minute by default.**

properties.description: NordPassActivities Data Parser with template version 3.1.0

properties.query:
let LoginTypes = dynamic(["login", "lock", "password", "biometric", "recovery_code"]);
let VaultTypes = dynamic(["item_actions", "item_share", "generated_password", "email_mask", "identity_mask", "redeem", "password_health"]);
let AdminTypes = dynamic(["invites", "roles", "access", "settings", "oauth_token_management", "oauth_credentials", "oauth_domain",
                          "scim_credentials", "group_provisioning", "groups", "domain", "integrations", "organization", "ip_rules",
                          "checkout", "consents", "breach", "security_key", "totp", "mfa_backup_codes", "sharing_hub"]);
let VaultTotpActions = dynamic(["2fa_item_accessed", "2fa_added_to_item", "2fa_removed_from_item", "2fa_item_created", "2fa_device_enrolled", "2fa_device_deleted"]);
NordPassEventLogs_CL
| extend
    schema_version = toint(column_ifexists("schema_version", int(null))),
    category = tostring(column_ifexists("category", "")),
    client_type = tostring(column_ifexists("client_type", "")),
    mode = tostring(column_ifexists("mode", "")),
    device = todynamic(column_ifexists("device", dynamic(null))),
    application = todynamic(column_ifexists("application", dynamic(null))),
    ip_address = tostring(column_ifexists("ip_address", "")),
    inserted_at = tolong(column_ifexists("inserted_at", long(null)))
| extend schema_version = coalesce(schema_version, 1)
| extend is_legacy = schema_version < 2
| extend event_type = case(
    is_legacy and event_type in ("item_access", "item_delete"), "item_actions",
    is_legacy and event_type in ("global_settings", "role_settings", "user_settings"), "settings",
    is_legacy and event_type == "billing", "checkout",
    event_type)
| extend action = case(
    is_legacy and action in ("global_settings_updated", "role_settings_updated", "user_settings_updated"), "settings_updated",
    is_legacy and action in ("role_settings_cleared", "user_settings_cleared"), "settings_cleared",
    action)
| extend
    client_type = iff(isempty(client_type), tostring(metadata.platform), client_type),
    ip_address = iff(isempty(ip_address), coalesce(tostring(metadata.ip_address), tostring(device.ip_address)), ip_address)
| extend category = case(
    isnotempty(category), category,
    event_type in (LoginTypes), "login",
    event_type in (VaultTypes), "vault",
    event_type == "breach" and action in ("email_breached", "credit_card_breached"), "vault",
    event_type == "consents" and action startswith "user_", "vault",
    event_type == "totp" and action in (VaultTotpActions), "vault",
    event_type in (AdminTypes), "admin",
    "")
| extend EventTime = unixtime_seconds_todatetime(timestamp)
| project-away is_legacy

properties.description:
This will alert you when Data Breach Scanner discovers data related to your organization's domains on the dark web.

!This rule should be enabled only by the organizations that have set up Data Breach Scanner in NordPass.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "breach" and action == "domain_breached"
| extend TargetEmail = user_email

properties.description: nordpass_Invite_declined_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.1.0
This will alert you when the user declines the invite to the NordPass organization.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "invites" and action == "user_invite_declined"
| extend TargetEmail = user_email

properties.description:
This will alert you if a user deletes items in bulk, namely, more than 10 items or in the span of 10 minutes. 
If a mix of bulk and one-off deletions were performed, this will group all actions and report the total number of items deleted.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "item_actions" and action == "items_deleted"
| extend item_count = array_length(todynamic(metadata).items)
| summarize total_items = sum(item_count) by user_email
| where total_items >= 10

properties.description: This will alert you if the deleted user's items have been removed without being transferred to another active user, as this could result in the loss of access to critical tools or information.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "item_actions" and action == "item_reassignment_deleted"
| extend TargetEmail = user_email

properties.description:
This will alert you when the user is manually invited, suspended, or deleted.

!This rule should be enabled only by organizations that have User and Group Provisioning enabled.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where (event_type == "invites" and action == "user_invited")
    or (event_type == "access" and action == "user_status_updated")
| extend Targets = coalesce(metadata.users, metadata.emails, pack_array(dynamic(null)))
| mv-expand Target = Targets
| extend
    TargetEmail = coalesce(tostring(Target.email), tostring(Target), user_email),
    TargetStatus = coalesce(tostring(Target.status), tostring(metadata.status))
| where action == "user_invited" or TargetStatus in ("suspended", "deleted")
| extend ActorEmail = user_email
| project-away Targets, Target

properties.description: nordpass_token_revoked_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.1.0
This will alert you when the event reporting token is revoked, posing the risk of active integration being blocked.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "integrations" and action == "activities_token_revoked"
| extend TargetEmail = user_email

properties.description: This will alert you when Data Breach Scanner discovers data related to a member of your organization on the dark web.
properties.displayName: NordPass - Member data found in breach
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "breach" and action == "email_breached"
| extend TargetEmail = user_email

properties.displayName: NordPass - Member data found in breach

properties.description: This will alert you if a user fails to log in to their NordPass account or SSO authentication three or more times in the last 24 hours.
nordpass_vault_exported_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.1.0

This will alert you if the vault has been exported, allowing you to review and evaluate the incident to mitigate potential risks.
NOTE: The organization can control whether it allows its members to export the vault, although we recommend that it always be disabled.
properties.query:
NordPassActivities
| where event_type == "item_actions" and action == "vault_exported"
| extend TargetEmail = user_email

properties.descriptionHtml:
Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

NordPass for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to automatically transfer Activity Log data from NordPass to Microsoft Sentinel and get real-time insights such as item activity, all login attempts, and security notifications. This allows you to stay informed by setting any needed alerts by your organization to monitor these security events.
